game_name: Taiko no Tatsujin RT: Nippon no Kokoro (Japan, TKN1 Ver.A)
general_issues: Development profile. Game compatibility varies; see TeknoS11 STATUS.md. Select a merged ROM ZIP and, where requested, a CHD from the game disc directory. Controls: Both players have independent Left Rim, Left Center, Right Center and Right Rim buttons driving the EXIO drum sensors. Select Down, Select Up and Enter are separate operator controls.
